Airdrop Claiming Guide Word Abstractor , Peter Pan , Pengyu , Ethan Francis Mar 25, 2025 • 4 min read Table of Contents: It’s time. We’re thrilled to announce that our native token, $PARTI , is now live—a pivotal milestone pushing us into the next phase of chain abstraction. $PARTI is the economic powerhouse behind the Particle Chain—Particle's L1 blockchain and the coordination engine behind Universal Accounts. As we release $PARTI into the world, we’re placing the economic power of Particle Network directly in the hands of those who believe in the vision of one account, one balance, any chain . $PARTI is designed to link Universal Accounts ’ growth and expansion to our network’s economic value. And so, it’s time for us to place that value directly into the hands of our community. This guide will cover how participants in Particle Network’s early community campaigns, as well as UniversalX users, can claim their $PARTI airdrop. Remember, claiming is open until April 30th! Eligibility and $PARTI Diamonds The $PARTI airdrop will distribute 9% of the total $PARTI supply, all in one go. To claim the Season 0 airdrop, you must have either traded on UniversalX or participated in one of Particle Network's previous community initiatives. Only wallets and accounts from these campaigns are eligible to receive $PARTI: UniversalX Season 0 Traders – users who traded or referred users on UniversalX, during or prior to the start of Season 0, and earned $PARTI Diamonds . Particle Pioneer (Testnet Phase) – early users who earned $PARTI points during our Testnet. The People’s Launchpad – participants in our Launchpad events for partner projects. The People’s Alliance ($ALLY) – members who joined the Alliance’s inscription campaign and held $ALLY. CAPYBARA NFT holders – members who hold our Launchpad’s mascot NFT. Particle Wallet or BTC Connect users – a small amount of $PARTI tokens will be reserved to be claimed by historical Particle Wallet (or BTC Connect) users on a first-come, first-served basis. Importantly, even though OG community members received a Diamonds bonus through Diamonds’ Season 0 , you don’t need to be a Diamonds holder to receive a $PARTI allocation—all community efforts will be rewarded. Next, let’s look into how you can claim to your Universal Account: Claiming $PARTI You can claim your airdrop directly to your Universal Account on UniversalX . To do so: 1: Log into UniversalX: Log into UniversalX with the account you used for $PARTI Diamonds. If you aren’t a prior UniversalX user, you can log in with any wallet (you can connect a Web3 wallet or log in via a social account). Note: The account you use to log in will NOT affect your claiming address. 2: Access the Airdrop claiming page: Open the UniversalX mobile app or desktop browser version. Click on the dedicated $PARTI airdrop banner or navigate to the airdrop section in the app’s menu. This will take you to the Claim interface. UniversalX’s home page is now ready to host $PARTI’s airdrop. 3: Link relevant accounts: Once on the Airdrop dashboard, you might also need to connect other accounts that you used to participate in previous campaigns. Follow the on-screen instructions to complete any required verifications. (Skip this step if you have already done this during the Diamonds campaign, or if you did not participate in prior community campaigns and only traded on UniversalX.) Linking accounts for ecosystem community campaigns on UniversalX. 4: View Your Allocation: Once connected (and verified, if needed), the interface will display your $PARTI allocation. Your final allocation will be displayed once you’ve connected all relevant accounts. 5: Initiate the claim: Click the option for the platform where you would prefer to claim. The system will then guide you through the process of claiming. After you’ve undergone claiming, the app will generate a transaction to deliver your $PARTI to your account. All gas fees are sponsored by Particle Network , so you won’t incur any expenses here. 6: Confirm and secure your tokens: After you approve the claim transaction, you should see a success notification. Once confirmed, the $PARTI tokens will be deposited into your claiming account. At this point, you have successfully claimed your airdrop! You can check your Account page to verify that the tokens have been added. You can also begin trading $PARTI immediately on UniversalX, or use it as a primary token to trade other assets. Final Reminders If you encounter any issues during the claiming process, reach out to our support channels (primarily our Discord ) for help. Stay tuned on our official blog and social media for upcoming updates. We’ll also soon be publishing a dedicated breakdown of $PARTI’s utility and tokenomics, so you can better understand how your stake in the Particle ecosystem will be forever linked to the widespread advances of Web3 as we enter the Abstraction Era . With your $PARTI claimed, you’ve officially joined the ranks of $PARTI token holders. You’re now a stakeholder in the latest evolutionary step of Web3—the final step towards turning our ecosystem into a Decentralized Internet. Thank you for being an early supporter of Particle Network! Particle Network's Chain Abstraction solutions are 100% free for developers and teams. By integrating them, you can set your project in a path to leveraging chain abstraction.
